meta.note: Thirteen universal wellness spokes for the free wheel-builder prototype. UNIVERSAL SPOKES, PERSONAL ORDERING — the thirteen are the same for everybody, and what the assessment personalises is WHERE a person enters the ring, never what the ring is made of. A bespoke thirteen per person fails the brother-in-law test: nobody can check a bespoke thirteen is reasonable.
meta.ordering: By redemption latency, shortest first — how soon the next chance to choose well comes round. Eating went early on the original wheel because its choice density makes it the most forgiving domain in a life; these sort the same way. `latency` is the rank; `nextChance` is the plain-English version of it.
meta.thirteenth: The 13th is the review spoke, per RA-19 in REASON-ABILITY-CANON.md — true of three of eight shipped programmes, so a strong default rather than a law. Followed here, and said out loud.
meta.axes: `axes` names which of the six questionnaire axes (O, C, E, A, N, R) inform this spoke's candidate statements and its confidence register. Nothing else about the assessment touches a spoke.
meta.status: DRAFT — Tom's to rule on. Minted for this prototype against the canon's shape, not lifted from a wellness listicle.
meta.claims: Non-clinical wellbeing. Nothing here is therapy, treatment or diagnosis; no spoke names a condition.

spokes.name: Settling yourself
spokes.what: What you do with the ninety seconds after something winds you up.

spokes.name: Eating
spokes.what: How you feed yourself across an ordinary day, not on your best day.

spokes.name: What you take in
spokes.what: The feeds, the news and the screens — what you let into your head, and when.

spokes.name: Moving
spokes.what: Motion woven through the day, rather than the occasional heroic effort.
spokes.nextChance: the next time you stand up

spokes.name: How you talk to yourself
spokes.what: The running commentary — and catching the script when it has you.
spokes.nextChance: the next sentence you say to yourself

spokes.name: Your patch
spokes.what: The room you're actually in, and how much of your attention it's quietly taking.

spokes.name: Stopping
spokes.what: Where the working day ends, and whether anything marks the edge.

spokes.name: Reaching out
spokes.what: The message you meant to send, the yes you nearly said, the person you thought of.
spokes.nextChance: the next time someone crosses your mind

spokes.name: What takes the edge off
spokes.what: The drink, the scroll, the snack, the box set — what you reach for at the end of a hard one.

spokes.name: Money, in the small
spokes.what: The everyday spends and the low hum of worry behind them.

spokes.name: Sleep
spokes.what: The hours, the room, and what happens in the half-hour before them.

spokes.name: The people closest
spokes.what: The handful of relationships that hold most of the weight.

spokes.name: Looking back
spokes.what: The lap itself — what you noticed, what stuck, what you'd point at again.
